look_here_first: Do not expect a classic big evening-primrose flower. This is a delicate gaura-type annual with small white flowers that fade pink, long-exserted stamens and style, and narrow hairy stems and leaves.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Master Plant Pool marks Oenothera patriciae Hays-local. Travis — documented at Reimer's Ranch Park. Williamson — UT Plant Resources Center provides a dedicated Williamson County treatment.

morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with O. jamesii and O. macrocarpa, O. patriciae has much smaller gaura-like flowers and a delicate annual habit rather than large yellow evening-primrose blossoms.
